sentences.text: I wake up at seven o'clock every morning.
After that, I brush my teeth and wash my face.
I usually have toast and eggs for breakfast.
sentences.translation: 我早餐通常吃吐司和鸡蛋。

sentences.text: Then I pack my bag and leave for work.
It takes about thirty minutes to get to the office.
sentences.translation: 到办公室大约需要三十分钟。
